title: Weird Barrel
wikitext:
A '''Weird Barrel''' can be found by a hammock near the pier of [[Stillheart Port]] in [[Northwind]]. Interacting with it while having [[Perfumed Letter (3)|Perfumed Letter #3]] allows for the acquisition of [[Perfumed Letter (4)|Perfumed Letter #4]] and a [[Violet Key]].
